name: services/plctests/update_result
description:
Update result of placement test for given user to 'new_value'.

If you want to avoid concurrency problems (if two or more users are modifying same results), you may specify "old_value" parameter. Result will be updated only if given value match with currently value in database.

arguments.name: user_id
arguments.description: ID of user whose grade will be updated

arguments.name: new_value
arguments.description: Number of points, that you want to set

arguments.name: old_value
arguments.default_value: (If parameter is unused, no check will be made)
arguments.description:
Number of points, that you expect that is current set.
                                          If you expect that result wasn't entered yet, set this parameter to null.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
An empty dictionary returned if the method has been executed successfully.
    Some keys may be added in the future.
errors:
• object_invalid - object is in invalid state.

    Possible reasons:

    • test_modified - test result probably was updated concurrently.

  • object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist; param_name is equal to id.
